title: Pet Terms: Deep-Clean Share After Pets Have Arrived
content:
# Pet terms — the deep clean after pets

**Term.** On a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, once pets have arrived, part of the pet fee pays for the deep clean after them and is kept: a cancellation dated on the check-in date keeps 20 percent of the refundable pet fee; a cancellation dated after the check-in date keeps 35 percent of it; a cancellation before the check-in date keeps none. The deep-clean share is taken from the refundable pet fee before the pet-fee refund is rounded to the cent.

The cancellation date is the date part of the cancellation time recorded on the stay, compared with the stay's check-in date.

## Day table

| Cancellation dated | Deep-clean share kept | Part of the refundable pet fee returned |
|---|---|---|
| any day before the check-in date | none | 100 percent |
| on the check-in date | 20 percent | 80 percent |
| any day after the check-in date | 35 percent | 65 percent |

## Illustration (hypothetical refundable pet fee of 45.00)

- Cancelled the day before check-in: nothing kept, 45.00 returned.
- Cancelled on the check-in date: 20 percent, 9.00, kept; 36.00 returned.
- Cancelled two days after check-in: 35 percent, 15.75, kept; 29.25 returned.
